# AI Summoner — llms.txt

> AI Summoner (aisummoner.com) — the product site by Apprentice Conjurer (@ConjurerLab).
> Products: the AI Learning Atlas (free 6-month AI engineering learning map for adults).
> Site: https://aisummoner.com/

## Pages

- [Home — AI Summoner](https://aisummoner.com/): product site homepage with a showcase (Atlas + Beginning of Infinity reading guide + Co-Existence reading guide).
- [AI Learning Atlas](https://aisummoner.com/atlas): interactive 6-month AI engineering learning map (1-day / 1-week / 1-month / 6-month zoom levels). Free. For adult learners, not for kids.
- [The Beginning of Infinity — 18 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/beginning-of-infinity/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to David Deutsch's *The Beginning of Infinity* (2011) — 496 pages retold as eighteen 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Language toggle: mirror / EN / CN. Night 1 live.
- [Co-Existence — Seven Nights](https://aisummoner.com/co-existence/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Ethan Mollick's *Co-Existence: The Next Phase of AI* (Oct 20, 2026) — 240 pages retold as seven 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. The agent era's third mode of working with AI is named Conjurer. Night 1 live.
- [The Atlas Story](https://aisummoner.com/atlas-story): the article telling the Atlas story — "Midnight Silicon Bistro: a small bistro that only opens late at night, and the server is an AI." Reached from inside the Atlas (story tab), not from the homepage showcase.
